title: Low-degree Fourier family size bound
statement: Let $n,d,\mathrm{size}$ be natural numbers and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb Q$ satisfy $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$. The family of subsets of an $n$-element coordinate set having size at most the prescribed circuit-learning degree for $d,\mathrm{size},\varepsilon$ has cardinality at most $(D+1)(n+1)^D$, where $D$ is that degree.
